items.topic: CORA planning and multilevel tibial deformity in hypophosphatemic rickets
items.destination_intent: Peds 2026 deformity-analysis teaching note when OITE logging is requested
items.teaching_point_placement: Adjacent to the Q97 explanation of adding a middle-segment axis when the end-segment axes yield an implausible CORA
items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded full-length AP lower-limb radiograph with the bank's solid and dashed reference lines. Q97 describes proximal tibial varus and shaft valgus, requiring a third middle-segment axis to identify two deformity apices. An implausible intersection prompts further analysis; translation can also displace the apparent CORA and should not be excluded by the line pattern alone.
